g1-implement.title: G1 ribbon core + synthetic tests: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Implement src/physics/ribbon.py with build_ribbon(laps_xy, n_grid, smooth_window, min_laps) -> dict. Algorithm: resample each lap onto common arc-length grid (n_grid stations); median XY per station; compute arc-length s of median path; kappa(s) = dtheta/ds from unwrapped atan2(dY,dX). Output: dict with distance_m (array) and curvature (array) matching PhysicsSimulator._extract_track_profile schema. Write tests/unit/physics/test_ribbon.py with: (1) synthetic circle test - n laps of a circle with known R, assert abs(kappa - 1/R) < 0.1/R at most stations (L1 truth-anchored); (2) noisy-laps test - pooled kappa std < single-lap kappa std (L2 noise-averaging invariant); (3) track_profile schema test - output has distance_m and curvature keys, both 1D arrays of length n_grid, distance_m monotone increasing. Run py -m pytest tests/unit/physics/test_ribbon.py -v and all physics unit tests.
